name: L0 Scaffold: Nox project, bindings and shaders
body: `nox.json`, `mist.json` (cgltf, stb_image), the SDL3 binding `nox bind-c` writes from SDL3's headers, the Nyx binding from `include/nyx/nyx.h`, the three shaders (`lit`, `lines`, `overlay`) rewritten in GLSL 4.50 with a build script that compiles them with `glslangValidator` and `spirv-cross` (as Nox's `examples/spinning-cube/build-shaders.sh` does), and a README with build steps for macOS and Arch.

comments.text: The Nox engine lives in engine/. tools/install-dependencies.sh links Mist's builds into generated/mist/ as a stand-in until mist resolve (Mist design, step 5) tells nox build where they are; replace it then. The Nyx binding links the shared libnyx-capi; L6 decides whether the game host needs nyx-capi-static instead (chaos-ui links the static one).

acceptance_criteria.text: `nox build` succeeds on an empty engine entry point linking SDL3, cgltf and stb_image
The shaders compile to SPIR-V and MSL from the build script
The README's build steps work on a fresh checkout

definition_of_done.text: PR into `nox-proto`, reviewed, with the milestone's checks passing
